title: Morning Dew on Petals (7 AM)
subtitle: 7 AM · Pastel sunrise & fresh dew
blurb: Early spring morning light over damp cherry petals — delicate felt piano, sunlit acoustic pluck, and soft dewdrop bells.

title: Bicycle by the Canal (10 AM)
subtitle: 10 AM · Breezy canal-side pedal
blurb: Sunlit mid-morning ride past blooming cherry trees — buoyant Rhodes chords, sparkling canal pluck, and a singing felt-piano hook.

title: Sakura & Raindrops (2 PM)
subtitle: 2 PM · Blossoms after a spring shower
blurb: The album's title track — warm afternoon sunshower over pink blossoms, lyrical felt piano, sparkling raindrop bells, and a relaxed chillhop pocket.

title: Green Tea Terrace (4:30 PM)
subtitle: 4:30 PM · Sunlit teahouse veranda
blurb: Warm late-afternoon sunlight on a wooden teahouse terrace — crisp A-major Rhodes comping, lively garden pluck, and sparkling chimes.

title: Pink Sky Overpass (7 PM)
subtitle: 7 PM · Rose-violet spring twilight
blurb: Soft pink-violet sunset seen from a pedestrian overpass — lush F-major Rhodes 9ths, expressive felt piano, and deep twilight sub-bass.

title: Petals on Wet Stone (11 PM)
subtitle: 11 PM · Quiet rain-washed spring night
blurb: Late-night spring stillness with cherry petals resting on wet stone — gentle felt piano, dreamy music-box bells, and whisper-soft brushes.
